climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Beaujolais cru for red wine from Gamay, on the border of the Rhône and Saône-et-Loire departments, in parts of Chénas and Romanèche-Thorins. Its name means windmill, and it gained AOC status in 1936.
